title: 第29章 剑术被直播了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁凡为郁景制定的计划对于普通人来说可能较为艰难，但也不是不可能完成。

    每天早上要围着别墅区跑五个来回，也就是大概二十公里的样子，随后便是练习一百次出剑与收剑，再练习最基础的剑法。

    第一天开始执行计划时，郁景差点没在路上直接跑断气。

    可根据他爷爷所说，这是以他自己的身体极限来安排的，所以他就算内心里不断的飘荡着不可能完成也憋着一口气努力的去做。

    2个多小时跑完后，郁景已经全身大汗淋漓了，好在还是坚持了下来。

    随后便按照爷爷吩咐的去练习出剑，他没有选择拿自己的剑，而是拿着一个小木棍在练习。

    刀剑无眼，更别说是这种开了刃的，看上去都挺危险的。

    至少暂时他还不敢去碰触这把剑。

    郁凡站在一旁看着郁景的练习，赞赏的点了点头。

    这孩子真的是个可造之材，不管是跑步还是挥剑，似乎只要告诉他怎么做，他便能努力的完成自己的任务。

    下午练习剑法的时候，郁凡选择了自家前院的大草坪，毕竟空间大。

    郁凡根据自己记忆中的一款基础剑法舞了一遍，剑法虽然简单却是极为凌厉的，速度快到似乎只能看到剑影。

    而这一幕正好被正在直播的郁颜给不小心拍摄到了。

    原本今天想给粉丝们一波福利的，但粉丝们要求今天把别墅都转一圈，完成昨天没有完成的任务。

    郁颜想到自己总是鸽鸽也不太好，她可是答应了王景焕要好好营业的，自然是同意粉丝们的要求。

    “天，这剑法！太厉害了！”

    “好快啊，我只能看到残影！”

    “何止是你，我感觉自己可能老花眼了。”

    “没有想到主播居然是武林世家吗？居然会武术。”

    郁颜看到弹幕后才注意到草坪上的郁凡和郁景。

    “爷爷，你们在练剑吗？”郁颜好奇的走过去。

    郁凡正在指导郁景练习第一式。

    “你哥已经踏入了门槛，现在已经在学习剑法了。”

    郁凡的口吻里不乏欣赏，郁颜不由的瘪瘪嘴，好嘛，这不就是在说她偷懒吗？

    “左手打直，腿不要弯。”
content_en:
The plan Yu Fan made for Yu Jing may be difficult for ordinary people, but it is not impossible to complete.

Every morning I have to run around the villa area five times, which is about 20 kilometers, and then practice drawing and sheathing the sword a hundred times, and then practice the most basic sword skills.

When Yu Jing started to implement the plan on the first day, he almost died on the road.

But according to what his grandfather said, this was arranged based on his own physical limits, so even though his heart kept wandering that it was impossible to complete, he still held his breath and worked hard to do it.

After running for more than 2 hours, Yu Jing was sweating profusely, but fortunately he persisted.

Then he followed his grandfather's instructions to practice drawing the sword. He did not choose to use his own sword, but practiced with a small wooden stick.

A sword without eyes, let alone one with an edge like this, looks quite dangerous.

At least for the time being, he didn't dare to touch the sword.

Yu Fan stood aside watching Yu Jing's practice and nodded appreciatively.

This kid is really a talented person. Whether it's running or swinging a sword, it seems that as long as you tell him what to do, he will work hard to complete his task.

When practicing swordsmanship in the afternoon, Yu Fan chose the large lawn in his front yard because there was plenty of space.

Yu Fan performed a dance based on a basic sword technique in his memory. Although the sword technique was simple, it was extremely powerful. The speed was so fast that only the shadow of the sword seemed to be visible.

This scene happened to be accidentally captured by Yu Yan who was live broadcasting.

Originally, I wanted to give fans a wave of benefits today, but fans asked me to go around the villa today to complete the tasks that were not completed yesterday.

Yu Yan thought that it was not good for her to be a pigeon all the time. She had promised Wang Jinghuan to run a good business, so she naturally agreed to the fans' request.

"God, this swordsmanship! It's so powerful!"

"It's so fast, I can only see the afterimage!"

"It's not just you, I feel like I might be presbyopic."

"Didn't you expect that the host is from a martial arts family? He actually knows martial arts."

Yu Yan only noticed Yu Fan and Yu Jing on the lawn after seeing the barrage.

"Grandpa, are you practicing swordsmanship?" Yu Yan walked over curiously.

Yu Fan is instructing Yu Jing to practice the first pose.

"Your brother has already crossed the threshold and is now learning swordsmanship."

There was a lot of appreciation in Yu Fan's tone, and Yu Yan couldn't help but pout, okay, isn't this just saying that she is lazy?

"Keep your left hand straight and don't bend your legs."
title_en: Chapter 29 The swordsmanship was broadcast live
